glossary.ярославнынъ: Ярославна — Yaroslavna's (possessive adj., nom. sg. masc., agreeing with гласъ; she is Igor's wife, daughter of Yaroslav Osmomysl of Galich, met in part 6)
glossary.гласъ: гласъ — voice (acc. sg., object of the impersonal слышитъ, 'one hears [her] voice')
glossary.слышитъ: слышати — hears (3sg present, impersonal use, 'one hears')
glossary.зегзицею: зегзица — cuckoo (instr. sg., comparison-instrumental, 'as/like a cuckoo')
glossary.незнаемь: незнаемь — unknown, unrecognized (worn short-form adj.; gender/case uncertain)
glossary.кычеть: кыкати — calls out, cries, of a bird (3sg present)
glossary.полечю: полетѣти — I will fly (1sg non-past, perfective)
glossary.дунаеви: Дунай — the Danube (dat. sg., after по, 'along the Danube')
glossary.омочю: омочити — I will wet, dip (1sg non-past, perfective)
glossary.бебрянъ: бебрянъ — of beaver fur (adj., acc. sg. masc., modifying рукавъ)
glossary.рѣцѣ: рѣка — river (loc. sg., in apposition to Каялѣ)
glossary.утру: утерти — I will wipe (1sg non-past, perfective)
glossary.князю: кънязь — to/upon the prince; for the prince (dat. sg.)
glossary.жестоцѣмъ: жестокъ — harsh, hard, battle-hardened (loc. sg. masc., modifying тѣлѣ)
glossary.ярославна: Ярославна — Yaroslavna (proper name, nom. sg.; Igor's wife, daughter of Yaroslav Osmomysl of Galich)
glossary.аркучи: аркати — saying (pres. active participle; a verb otherwise unattested in Old East Slavic outside this poem)
glossary.вѣтрѣ: вѣтръ — O wind! (address after о, loc.-looking sg.)
glossary.вѣтрило: вѣтрило — sail (nom./voc. sg.; an old word for 'sail', distinct from вѣтръ 'wind')
glossary.хиновьскыя: Хиновьскый — Khin, of Хинова (adj., acc. pl. fem., modifying стрѣлкы); cf. «Хинова» in part 6, an obscure, half-legendary distant people or land at the edge of the known world, whether preserving a folk-memory of the Huns or a later name for a far-eastern land unresolved — here, in the context of Igor's rout, most likely standing for Cuman/Polovtsian horse-archers
glossary.трудною: трудный — toiling, wearying (instr. sg. fem., negated by не, 'untoiling')
glossary.крилцю: крилце — little wing (a crux of case: instrumental-looking phrase attached to a noun that looks dative/locative sg., see note)
glossary.моея: мой — my (gen. sg. fem., modifying лады)
glossary.лады: лада — dear one, beloved (gen. sg.; an old term of endearment for one's own husband, here Igor; the construal of «лады вои» is contested)
glossary.ли: ли — interrogative/emphatic particle (here rhetorical, 'was it too little ... ?')
glossary.ти: ты — for you, to you (dat. sg., enclitic)
glossary.бяшетъ: быти — was / would be (imperfect 3sg; here conditional 'would it be')
glossary.горъ: гора — mountains (gen. pl., after мало, 'too little of the mountains', i.e. 'among the mountains')
glossary.лелѣючи: лелѣяти — cradling, nursing (pres. active participle; same root as «лелѣялъ» and «възлелѣй» below, and «лелѣяны» of the Kurian warriors in part 1)
glossary.синѣ: синь — blue (loc. sg. neut., modifying морѣ)
glossary.мое: мой — my (nom. sg. neut., modifying веселіе)
glossary.ковылію: ковылие — feather-grass (dat./loc.-looking sg., after по, 'along the feather-grass'; the characteristic grass of the open steppe)
glossary.плачеть: плакати(ся) — weeps, cries (3sg present; = плачетъ, a spelling variant)
glossary.городу: городъ — town (dat. sg., in apposition to Путивлю)
glossary.заборолѣ: заборало — rampart, wall-walk (loc. sg.; = забрало, a spelling variant)
glossary.днепре: Днепръ — O Dnepr! (vocative sg.; the river)
glossary.словутицю: словутичь — renowned one, far-famed one (vocative sg.; traditional honorific epithet of the Dnepr, surviving into later East Slavic/Ukrainian folk-song tradition as Словута/Словутиця)
glossary.пробилъ: пробити — broken through, pierced (past participle, in the periphrastic perfect «пробилъ еси», 'you have broken through')
glossary.каменныя: каменный — stone, rocky (acc. pl., modifying горы)
glossary.половецкую: Половецкая — Cuman, Polovtsian (adj., acc. sg. fem., modifying землю)
glossary.лелѣялъ: лелѣяти — cradled, nursed (past participle, in the periphrastic perfect «лелѣялъ еси», 'you have cradled')
glossary.себѣ: себе — upon itself, for itself (dat./loc.-looking reflexive sg.; refers to the Dnepr)
glossary.святославли: Святославль — Svyatoslav's (possessive adj., acc. pl., modifying носады; Svyatoslav Vsevolodovich of Kiev, of the Golden Word in parts 5–6)
glossary.носады: носадъ — boats, river-boats (acc. pl.; a shallow-draft Rus' river boat used on campaigns down the Dnepr)
glossary.до: до — up to, as far as (prep. + gen.)
glossary.плъку: пълкъ — army, host (gen. sg., after до, 'as far as ... host')
glossary.кобякова: Кобяковъ — Kobyak's (possessive adj., gen. sg. masc., modifying плъку; the Polovtsian khan defeated and captured by Svyatoslav's 1183 Dnepr campaign)
glossary.мою: мой — my (acc. sg. fem., modifying ладу)
glossary.ладу: лада — dear one, beloved (acc. sg.; unambiguously names Igor by this endearment)
glossary.быхъ: быти — I would (old aorist-derived conditional auxiliary, ancestor of modern 'бы'; with неслала forms a conditional/purpose construction, 'so that I would not send')
glossary.неслала: нести — did not carry, send (past participle fem. sg., negated; with «быхъ», 'I would not send')
glossary.слезъ: слеза — tears (gen. pl., genitive of negation after неслала)
glossary.тепло: тепло — warm (short-form/nominal neut. adj., predicative, agreeing with слънце's grammatical gender though addressed in the 2nd person)
glossary.красно: красьно — beautiful, fair (short-form/nominal neut. adj., predicative; the older sense of красный, not 'red')
glossary.свѣтлое: свѣтлый — bright (nom. sg. neut., vocative address, modifying слънце)
glossary.тресвѣтлое: тресвѣтлый — thrice-bright (adj., nom. sg. neut.; an intensifying compound, тре- 'three-' + свѣтлое 'bright', found nowhere else in the poem)
glossary.всѣмъ: вьсь — to all, to everyone (dat. pl.)
glossary.простре: прострѣти — stretched forth (aorist 2sg; a bare aorist, distinct from the periphrastic perfect used of the Dnepr's feats)
glossary.горячюю: горячий — hot, scorching (acc. sg. fem., modifying лучю)
glossary.ладѣ: лада — dear one, beloved (loc./dat.-looking sg.; echoes «лады» in unit 4, though the ending differs — whether a further spelling inconsistency or a genuine case shift is not settled)
glossary.безводнѣ: безводьнъ — waterless (adj., loc. sg. neut., modifying полѣ)
glossary.жаждею: жажда — thirst (instr. sg., instrumental of means, 'with thirst')
glossary.лучи: луча — rays (acc. pl.; kept as printed — some editors instead read «луки», 'bows,' paralleling «тули», 'quivers'; neither reading is asserted as certain)
glossary.тугою: туга — anguish, grief (instr. sg., instrumental of means, 'with anguish')
glossary.тули: тулъ — quivers (acc. pl.; same form as nom., an inanimate noun)
